t: What Interdisciplinary Discovery Database Is All About
title: What Interdisciplinary Discovery Database Is All About
description: The biggest breakthroughs happen at field boundaries: physics met biology and gave us MRI; mathematics met evolution and gave us genetic algorithms. Interdisciplinary discovery is a skill: learn the deep structure of one field, then hunt for the same structure wearing a different uniform in another. Analogies are the bridge; testing is the toll. This database is the complete cross-field discovery: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Interdisciplinary Discovery Database: a complete reference database of full cross-field discovery records.
key_points: What this database holds: full cross-field discovery records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

Every record is the full entry — never a stub or description alone.

description: Every field has its own language. definition: The working vocabulary of Interdisciplinary Discovery Database: the terms practitioners actually use.

analogy: structural similarity across different domains
emergence: complex behavior arising from simple rules
scale-free network: network with hub nodes following a power law
consilience: unity of knowledge across disciplines
technology transfer: moving methods from one field to another
